question: Which of the following countries hosted the first edition of the Summer Youth Olympic Games in 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Singapore__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The inaugural winter version took place in **Innsbruck**, **Austria** from 13 to 22 January 2012, while the **first summer version took place in Singapore from 14 to 26 August 2010**.
 
• **The International Olympic Committee (IOC)** organises the **Youth Olympic Games (YOG)**, an international multisport **competition for competitors between the ages of 15 and 18.**
 
• Similar to the present** Olympic Games** pattern, the games are held every four years and alternate between summer and winter competitions.
 
• However, the **Olympic Winter Games** are held in leap years rather than the summer competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Youth Olympic Games**

 
 
• **Johann Rosenzopf, an Austrian industrial manager, came up with the idea for the Youth Olympic Games in 1998.**
 
• This was in reaction to growing worries about juvenile obesity and a decline in kid engagement in sports, particularly among those in affluent countries, on a global scale.
 
• It was also acknowledged that a youth-focused** Olympics would encourage participation in the main event.**
 
• The **IOC's** response of conducting a strictly sporting event was unfavourable despite these arguments in favour of having an **Olympic event** for young people.
